steps.title: Prepare Liquid Nitrogen Container
steps.instruction: Pour liquid nitrogen into a polystyrene cooler or another container that can safely hold liquid nitrogen.

steps.title: Collect Plant Tissue
steps.instruction: Collect tissue from the plant and place it into a tube.

substeps.instruction: Clean scissors or forceps with ethanol prior to collection

steps.title: Flash Freeze Tissue
steps.instruction: Immediately plunge the tube into liquid nitrogen to preserve transcription profiles.

steps.title: Transport and Store Samples
steps.instruction: Transfer tubes into a cooler containing dry ice for transport to a -80C freezer.

substeps.instruction: Store samples at -80C until ready for extraction
